title: A Group Chat for the Detention
author: Orsen Iversen
blurb: Jude Dravenmoor, a coder whose anonymous account knows too much, stays under the radar: head down, grades up, locker shut. Then a best friend goes missing, leaving only a set of keys behind — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, she must expose what the school board buried before prom.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
